description: Configurable data sufficiency and screening rules for multi-crop agricultural forecasting readiness

classification_definitions.MODEL_READY: Crop satisfies all data volume, target completeness, temporal continuity, and active geographic representation requirements to support rigorous out-of-time chronological validation.
classification_definitions.ANALYTICS_READY: Crop provides reliable historical observations for exploratory, regional, and comparative analytics, but exhibits localized cultivation, sparse active districts, or target zero-inflation precluding robust ML generalization.
classification_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Crop possesses insufficient longitudinal records, severe temporal fragmentation, or extreme missingness precluding both modeling and descriptive analytics.
